hypotheses.justification: A scheme stalk is a local ring, and an integrally closed local ring is a domain. Thus the remaining hypothesis `[_root_.IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk y)]` supplies this domain property, so the explicit domain assumption can be removed; the localization argument then applies unchanged. The stalk at a scheme point is nontrivial, so there is no zero-ring exception.
